subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Queer
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"queer"** means something that is strange, odd, or unusual. (अजीब)

 
 
• **Example: **He felt a **queer** sensation in his stomach before the speech.
 
 
 
• **"Ordinary" **refers to something that is normal, usual, or commonplace. (साधारण)
 
 
• **Example: **She led a very **ordinary** life, without any major surprises.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'queer' **is **'ordinary'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eccentric **(अजीब): Unconventional and slightly strange.

 
 
• **Example:** His** eccentric** behavior made him the talk of the town.
 
 
 
• **Fantastic **(अद्भुत): Extraordinarily good or attractive.
 
 
• **Example: **The movie was **fantastic** and exceeded all our expectations.
 
 
 
• **Doubtful** (संदेहास्पद): Feeling uncertain about something.
 
 
• **Example:** I am** doubtful **about the success of this plan.
